_what: How Studio keeps the palm or the back of a hand on top while you drag the hand or type where its wrist goes (A45-28). dragRangeDeg: while dragging, how far round each way the arm may swing to keep that side up (small = the arm keeps its shape; the whole swing is searched when you let go). stepDeg: the steps of that search. reachMm: a gap this small counts as reached. stopDeg: this close to a joint limit counts as at its stop. avoidSelfHit: never turn the arm into a shape that hits the body or the other arm.
